decision_conditions:
The development hereby permitted shall begin not later
than the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and supporting documents and thereafter maintained as such for the lifetime of the development:drawing number: dated:drawing number(s):  dated:documents entitled:

Within three months of the date of this permission, full details relating to the following shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority: a) The design of secure, lockable and enclosed cycle stores, b) Refuse and recycling facilities (including details of level and type of provision, location and impact on visual amenity). The development shall be carried out fully in accordance with the approved details prior to first occupation of the development and shall be thereafter maintained as such for the lifetime of the development.

Within three months of the date of this permission, full details relating to how the development would comply with principles of Secured by Design including details of (i) Management Strategy, (ii) Main Communal Entrances, (iii) Access Control, (iv) Visitor Access, (v) Residential Front Doors, (vi) Accessible Windows & Doors, (vii) Postal Delivery, (viii) Lightweight Door Frame Surround, (ix) Lightweight framed walls, (x) CCTV, (xi) Utility Smart Meters, (xii) Internal communal Lighting, (xiii) External Lighting, (xiv) Cycle Storage  shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details prior to the first occupation of the development hereby approved and thereafter shall be fully retained and maintained as such for the lifetime of the development.

Within three months of the date of this permission, formal written confirmation or closure documentation issued by the London Fire Commissioner shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority confirming that all fire safety deficiencies identified in the Notification of Fire Safety Deficiencies dated 9 February 2026 have been fully remedied and that there are no outstanding contraventions under the Regulatory Reform (Fire Safety) Order 2005 (as amended). The development shall thereafter be retained in accordance with those remedial measures.
description: Continued use as a Sui Generis HMO for up to 7 people with associated secure cycle storage and refuse and recycling storage.
